## Set Up

```{r setup, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Set default ggplot theme
theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", linewidth = 0.5)
    )
)

# some helpful settings
options(
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, 
  readr.show_col_types = FALSE
)

set.seed(2025)
```

```{r}
# source in some helper functions we'll use to prep data 
# build_spectra_mtx() build_spectra_cor_df() filter_spectra()
source("./utils/spectra-helper-functions.R")
```

```{r}
# paths to custom geneset files we're going to use for ORA
geneset_file <- file.path("..", "genesets", "custom-gene-sets.tsv")
msigdb_geneset_file <- file.path("..", "genesets", "msigdb-gene-sets.tsv")
category_file <- file.path("..", "genesets", "gene-set-categories.tsv")
```


```{r}
results_dir <- fs::path("..", "ews-nf-out", "cnmf")

# get all the spectra files
spectra_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  path = results_dir, 
  glob = "*.gene_spectra_score.k_*.dt_*.txt", 
  recurse = TRUE
  )

# extract the unique ID for labeling
unique_ids <- stringr::str_extract(spectra_files, pattern = "SCPCL[0-9]+-SCPCS[0-9]+")
names(spectra_files) <- unique_ids
```

```{r}
# read in and build spectra mtx
spectra_mtx <- build_spectra_mtx(spectra_files)

# get correlations
cor_mtx <- cor(spectra_mtx, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# create correlation dataframe with info about each spectra
all_cor_df <- build_spectra_cor_df(cor_mtx)
```

```{r}
dist_mtx <- as.dist(1-cor_mtx)
tree <- hclust(dist_mtx, method = "ward.D2")
clusters <- cutree(tree, k = 12)
mp_cluster_list <- split(colnames(spectra_mtx), clusters)
names(mp_cluster_list) <- glue::glue("MP{names(mp_cluster_list)}")

# generate mps 
mp_list <- mp_cluster_list |> 
  purrr::map(\(spectra_list){
    
    mps <- rowMeans(spectra_mtx[, spectra_list, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) |>
      sort(decreasing = TRUE)
    
  })
```


## Correlation between MPs

```{r}
# combine all mps into a matrix for a heatmap
# get correlation to each other
mp_mtx <- do.call(cbind, mp_list)
mp_cor_matrix <- cor(mp_mtx, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  mp_cor_matrix
)
```

## Sample diversity 

```{r}
mp_df <- mp_cluster_list |> 
  purrr::imap_dfr(\(spectra_list, mp_name) {
    tibble::tibble(
      metaprogram = mp_name,
      spectra = spectra_list
    )
  }) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = stringr::word(spectra, 1, sep = "_") |> 
      stringr::word(-1, sep = "-")
  )


mp_prop_df <- mp_df |> 
  dplyr::group_by(metaprogram, sample_id) |>
  # generate one row per mp/sample combination with the total count
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), 
                   .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  # get the frequency of each sample compared to all other samples
  dplyr::mutate(p = n / sum(n),
                num_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_id)
  )

sample_diversity_df <- mp_prop_df |> 
  # now the shannon index for each metaprogram 
  dplyr::summarise(
    shannon = -sum(p * log(p)), # entropy
    num_samples = unique(num_samples), # get unique value for printing
    shannon_norm = shannon / log(num_samples)
    ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(shannon_norm)) 

sample_diversity_df |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

```{r}
mp_prop_df <- mp_prop_df |> 
  # ungroup before setting levels otherwise the plot doesn't work
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::mutate(metaprogram = forcats::fct_reorder(metaprogram, num_samples))

ggplot(mp_prop_df, aes(x = p, y = metaprogram, fill = sample_id)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    y = "Metaprogram",
    x = "Proportion of spectra",
    fill = "Sample"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette.colors("alphabet", n=13))
```

## Biological interpretability 

```{r}
# read in custom gene lists and EF msigdb gene sets to look at 
geneset_df <- readr::read_tsv(geneset_file)
ef_msigdb_df <- readr::read_tsv(msigdb_geneset_file)

# use hallmarks in addition to EF lists 
hallmarks_msigdb_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") |> 
  dplyr::select(gs_name, ensembl_gene)
```

```{r}
# get list of categories that we need to grab from msigdb
category_list <- ef_msigdb_df |>
  dplyr::select(category, subcategory) |>
  unique() |>
  purrr::transpose()


# list of genesets and names
geneset_list <- ef_msigdb_df$geneset |>
  purrr::set_names(ef_msigdb_df$name)

# first pull out info for each category and then pull out specific genes for geneset
ef_geneset_df <- category_list |>
  purrr::map(\(category_list){
    # replace subcategory with default NULL
    # can't use NULL in tsv since it gets read in as a character
    if (is.na(category_list$subcategory)) {
      subcategory <- NULL
    } else {
      subcategory <- category_list$subcategory
    }
    
    msigdbr::msigdbr(
      species = "Homo sapiens",
      collection = category_list$category,
      subcollection = subcategory
    )
  }) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  # only keep relevant gene sets
  dplyr::filter(gs_name %in% geneset_list) |> 
  dplyr::select(gs_name, ensembl_gene)

# combine into a single term2df for running GSEA and ORA
all_term_df <- geneset_df |> 
  dplyr::select(gs_name = geneset, ensembl_gene = ensembl_gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::bind_rows(ef_geneset_df) |> 
  dplyr::bind_rows(hallmarks_msigdb_df) |> 
  tidyr::drop_na()
```

```{r}
# get the universe of HVGs across all input samples
universe <- rownames(spectra_mtx)
```

```{r}
ora_results <- mp_list |> 
  purrr::map(\(scores){
    genes <- names(scores)[1:200]
    
    ora_results <- clusterProfiler::enricher(
      gene = genes,
      universe = universe,
      TERM2GENE = all_term_df
    )
  })

ora_results_df <- ora_results |> 
  purrr::imap_dfr(\(result, mp_name) {
    result@result |> 
      dplyr::mutate(metaprogram = mp_name) |> 
      dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= 0.1) 
  })
```

```{r}
heatmap_mtx <- ora_results_df |> 
  dplyr::mutate(logp = -log10(p.adjust)) |>        # convert to -log10
  dplyr::select(metaprogram, ID, logp) |>  # keep only needed columns
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = metaprogram,
    values_from = logp,
    values_fill = 0  # set missing gene sets to 0                         
  ) |> 
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  heatmap_mtx,
  name = "-log10(pvalue)",
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_dend_side = "right"
)
```

```{r}
ora_results_df |> 
  dplyr::group_by(ID) |>
  # now the shannon index for each metaprogram 
  dplyr::summarise(
    shannon = -sum(pvalue * log(pvalue)), # entropy
    num_mps = dplyr::n_distinct(metaprogram), # get unique value for printing
    shannon_norm = shannon / log(num_mps),
    metaprograms = paste0(metaprogram, collapse = ",")
    ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(metaprograms) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```


```{r}
mp_specificity_df <- ora_results_df |> 
  dplyr::group_by(metaprogram) |>
  # now the shannon index for each metaprogram 
  dplyr::summarise(
    shannon = -sum(pvalue * log(pvalue)), # entropy
    num_genesets = length(unique(ID)), # get unique value for printing
    shannon_norm = shannon / log(num_genesets)
    ) 

mp_specificity_df |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

```{r}
mp_cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(mp_cor_matrix)) |>
  dplyr::rename(mp1 = Var1, mp2 = Var2, correlation = Freq) |> 
  dplyr::filter(mp1 != mp2) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_mp_cor = max(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = mp1
  ) |> 
  dplyr::rename(metaprogram = mp1)

diversity_df <- sample_diversity_df |> 
  dplyr::select(metaprogram, diversity = shannon_norm)

specificity_df <- mp_specificity_df |> 
  dplyr::select(metaprogram, specificity = shannon_norm) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(specificity = dplyr::if_else(is.infinite(specificity), 0, specificity))

all_stats_mtx <- mp_cor_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(specificity_df, by = "metaprogram") |>
  dplyr::left_join(diversity_df, by = "metaprogram") |> 
  tibble::column_to_rownames("metaprogram") |> 
  as.matrix()


all_stats_mtx[is.na(all_stats_mtx)] <- 0

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(all_stats_mtx)
```
